data.rationale: The proposal gets the core flow right (open the special events list, open an event, pick the ticket count, Book Now, Reserve Now), but it omits the city and date parameters, adds an event parameter and an extra NEXT step, and leaves the city selection and the time-slot choice vague, so an automation would have to guess at several steps.
